verdict.rationale: Linear's own marketing says it automatically turns conversations and feedback into issues that are routed, labeled, and prioritized, and that users can delegate entire issues end-to-end to agents. Both describe autonomous background work, but the evidence is thin marketing copy. Building your own agents via the developer platform is a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation rules or triggers, recurring/scheduled background runs, details of how delegated agents execute unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
Work on complex tasks together or delegate entire issues end-to-end.
To automatically associate Asks from a shared Slack channel with a customer, open the customer page and choose **Link to Slack channel** from the **…** menu.
